newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Peru's Edelnor raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Peru's Edelnor raised.

text.p: Santander Investment analyst Samuel Gomez raised his rating on Peruvian power company Edelnor SA Monday to market perform from underperform.
-- "At current levels, we believe that the shares are fairly valued and expect the stock to perform in line with the market over the next 12 months," he wrote in a report.

-- "Thus, we are upgrading our rating ... and lowering our price target from 2.80 soles to 2.60 soles, which represents upside of 25 percent. This compares with our 20 percent expected return for the market."
-- The company's shares were up 0.03 sol to 1.90 soles in Lima.
